problem.title: Count Dead Ends in a Binary Search Tree
problem.problemStatement: Given the root of a Binary Search Tree containing positive integers, determine the number of dead-end nodes where no further insertion is possible while maintaining the BST property.
problem.input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The next N lines describe the BST.
problem.output: • Print the number of dead ends.
